Name: Every Issue Repairs. Style: Repairs and maintenance for homes, landlords and letting agents. Address: Unit 4, Fernhill Trade Park, Nottingham NG7 (example). Works in England.
Area: We cover Nottingham, Derby, Loughborough, Beeston, West Bridgford and Long Eaton.
Office hours: Monday to Friday: 8am till 5:30pm. Saturday: 9am till 12 noon. Closed Sundays. Out of hours, an engineer is on call for emergencies.

Trades: gas, boilers and heating; boiler servicing and gas safety records; plumbing and leaks; drains and blockages; electrics, EICRs and PAT; roofs and gutters; carpentry and handyman; locks and lockouts; glazing and boarding up; decorating; damp and mould. Doesn't do: pest control (suggest someone else), lifts (suggest the building's lift contractor), white goods (suggest the manufacturer or the shop it came from), asbestos removal (suggest a licensed contractor: the HSE keeps a register).
Visits: morning 8am to 1pm, afternoon 12 noon to 5pm and evening 5pm to 4pm (£30 extra). Emergencies, day and night: we aim to attend within 4 hours and make safe within 24.

Prices: Call-out £95, with the first hour, then £40 a half hour. Nights and weekends: £150 for the first hour. A landlord's gas safety record is £75 for one appliance, plus £15 for each extra one. A boiler service is £85, or £130 for both on one visit. Free quotes over £500. Guarantee: Our workmanship is guaranteed for 12 months; parts carry the maker’s warranty.

Payment: Homeowners pay on completion by card or bank transfer; landlords and agents on account, within 14 days. Cancellation: You can cancel free of charge until 5pm the working day before your visit.
Accreditations: Gas Safe 512345 (example), NICEIC. Insurance: £5 million public liability (example).

Asbestos: If we find anything that might be asbestos, we stop and arrange for it to be tested before any work goes on. Parking: Please let us know about any parking restrictions; a permit or a space on the drive helps. Careers: We’re always glad to hear from qualified engineers: take a message and the office will call back.
